title: Construct BST from Preorder Traversal
constraints: preorder is guaranteed to be a valid BST preorder traversal.
inputFormat: Implement bstFromPreorder(preorder), where preorder is a valid root-left-right traversal of a BST with unique values.
outputFormat: The root node of the BST, using val, left, and right fields. The runner displays it in level order, trimming trailing nulls.
